content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-416. - Penalty.
content.summary:

               of…

faqs.a:
Any person who willfully files a false or incomplete disclosure statement, amendment
               or notice that no amendment is required or who willfully files a false or incomplete
               copy of any federal income tax return or a false or incomplete certified statement
               of investments or who willfully fails to make any filing required by
sections 2-411
—
2-416
shall be guilty of a violation of the ordinances of the city, punishable as a misdemeanor,
               and shall, upon conviction thereof, be punished by a fine not to exceed the limits
               established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1960, § 2-3.4(f); Code 1981, § 2-8)
State Law reference—
Issuing a false financial statement, C.R.S. § 18-5-209.
